gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-catamaran: Cherry Swash opens its c wide like a horseshoe and keeps its diagonals as heavy as its verticals, which gives headings a bold, distinctive look. And Catamaran follows with curvy, unclamped sans-serif letters that loosen the page and keep it approachable.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Stencil-brush plainness, wide and confident. Chiron Hei HK carries the text in a modern sans-serif whose c opens like a bracelet pulled apart, and Cherry Swash's heavy diagonals stay in the headline where they belong.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-commissioner: Commissioner draws a smooth sans with no clogged curves, every stroke at one thickness. But Cherry Swash is the one with presence, its horseshoe c and heavy diagonals doing the shouting while the body simply gets on with the reading.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-didact-gothic: Cherry Swash flings its c open like a horseshoe and weights its diagonals as heavily as its verticals. Didact Gothic then reads smoothly through a long stretch, its bowls never closing up and each stroke carrying the same visual weight.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-dotgothic16: That horseshoe-shaped c and the heavy diagonals make Cherry Swash instantly recognizable as a display face. DotGothic16 gives it tube-like, approachable text below.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-doto: Cherry Swash keeps its bar thickness identical across the line, with a horseshoe c that announces itself. Doto does the quieter job, spacing each glyph with generous margins and round letters with wide mouths.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-el-messiri: El Messiri reads clean and modern, with a lightly shaded texture and a wide slot between the c's two ends. And Cherry Swash, with its pencil-line consistency, takes the heading; the body text can go a little larger if it feels tight.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-electrolize: Cherry Swash holds a constant pen-pressure look, its c opened wide like a horseshoe and its diagonals as heavy as its verticals. And Electrolize, with an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, can go a touch larger as sans text.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-elms-sans: Elms Sans draws a ballpoint-like line with no pressure change, and you can see through the gap in each s. Cherry Swash adds the swagger.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-encode-sans: Encode Sans keeps its gaps wide enough that c never passes for o. Cherry Swash frames its counters with same-width strokes and a horseshoe c, so the headline stands out while the text stays crisp beneath it.
